definitions.explanation: A medical professional who specializes in diagnosing and treating conditions of the teeth and mouth.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}が{痛|いた}いので、{歯科医|しかい}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: My tooth hurts, so I made an appointment with the dentist.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}に{一度|いちど}は{歯科医|しかい}で{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}けたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should get a dental checkup once every six months.

notes:
{歯科医|しかい} is the formal term for dentist. In everyday conversation, {歯医者|はいしゃ} is more commonly used.

RELATED TERMS:
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}: dentist (casual, everyday term)
- {歯科|しか}: dentistry; dental department
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}: dental clinic

The {科|か} in {歯科|しか} means "department" or "branch of medicine," the same as in {内科|ないか} (internal medicine) and {外科|げか} (surgery).
